blurb: Guests can enjoy family-friendly whitewater rafting on a half-mile section of the Androscoggin River with class II and some class III rapids. Canoe and kayak rentals are available for exploring the Magalloway River, Lake Umbagog, and surrounding wilderness areas with options for single and multi-day trips. Camping is offered at two campgrounds: Northern Waters Base Camp in town and Cedar Stump Campground accessible by boat only.
